actual_configuration_custody.parent_reported_public_inspection: Parent reports a separately qualified public inspection of all24 persisted keys, no unknown/missing fields, five neutral additions, and changed legacy capacities; that inspection is not independently replayed here.
actual_configuration_custody.requirements: Construct current ResourceSchedulerConfig from the authenticated complete24-key stored config, preserving every legacy value and lane reservation. Never substitute old4CPU/9830MiB/4child/headroom2458, native defaults, or the candidate own2CPU/1536MiB/1child envelope for shared capacities.
actual_configuration_custody.source_conclusion_independent_of_actual_: Even neutral new fields cannot justify the old scheduler: current PID admission, recovery/pressure logic and deferred-release semantics differ.

configuration.neutral_subclass_assessment: A strict full24 roundtrip subclass around old config could preserve serialized settings only if the five additions were typed neutral, but would omit the current PID, pressure, stale-owner and release guards. It is rejected as the integration route.
configuration.new_validation: Profile must be None or local-benchmark@1. Recovery bool requires safety when enabled. Samples/grants are exact ints1..1024; interval numeric nonbool finite .001..3600. The local-benchmark profile enforces its native tighter safety/recovery settings and explicit absolute default-state env path. Preserve and call native validation, not a copied relaxed validator.

decision: Use the full current native resource_scheduler.py and proof_resource_safety.py closure, with versioned exact-config adoption/guardian/watchdog adapters. Reject silently retaining old native guards, including when the five new settings are neutral.
focused_future_controls: Exact authenticated full24 config survives constructor and acquire/renew/release while all foreign leases/waiters/recovery metadata persist; no setdefault upgrade, capacity reset or untrusted lane coercion.
Reject missing/extra/wrongtyped config keys, changed lane reservation, corrupt recovery, absent/empty scheduler state and any native constructor request to reconfigure.
Neutral recovery still exercises current PID headroom refusal; adequate PID but memory/PSI refusal stays native. No invented available resources or idle-state assumptions.

Native release with a live descendant retains ancestor reservation and watchdog reports deferred/incomplete closure; after actual drain, leaf/ancestor absence can pass. Foreign records remain untouched.
Wrong source hash, mixed old/new proof module, package module preloading, optional model import, wrong endpoint, changed cap/root identity or lock identity fails closed.

additional_eager_dependency.required_if: Executing the native top package initializer follows its unconditional try-import of router_deps before MINIMAL_IMPORTS branching. RouterDeps has only stdlib eager imports; its Accelerate import is inside a later callable and must not be invoked.

import_snapshot_assessment.fully_current_owned_checkout: Can supply exact current bytes, but an unrestricted full-tree sys.path allows eager/optional/lazy dependencies outside the six-file pins. Native package initialization therefore needs explicit minimal flags, eager router_deps pin, audited module-origin allowlist and fresh-process checks; do not claim six-file closure without those.
import_snapshot_assessment.narrow_bootstrap_alternative: A separately source-qualified bootstrap may create canonical inert ModuleType package shells with exact bounded __path__/__package__/__file__ values, then load unchanged telemetry,proof,scheduler under their canonical fully-qualified names. This avoids executing package initializers and router_deps. Explicitly disclose that three init files are custody pins, not executed; no native package-init equivalence claim. Deny preexisting ipfs_datasets modules and imports from any other source tree. This bootstrap itself is new code requiring independent review before use.
import_snapshot_assessment.native_initialization_effects: Top ipfs_datasets_py init deduplicates root logger handlers, constructs an inert installer object, probes optional module specs, and can import MCP/FastAPI/KNN/finance modules depending on environment. Minimal-import flags suppress broad optional branches but do not suppress router_deps or root-logging mutation. Missing snapshot router_deps is swallowed and changes package exports; absence is not proof of six-file closure.
import_snapshot_assessment.not_qualified_here: No package was imported; no import-time side effects were dynamically tested, and no proposed snapshot/bootstrap exists in this review.
import_snapshot_assessment.preferred_explicit_source_snapshot: Create a new exclusive F16-owned resource-source snapshot with byte-exact copies of current six resource/init files, plus router_deps if native init will execute. Keep historical source untouched. Copying source does not relocate live scheduler/ledger endpoints. Pin/hash every copy and its current-source origin.

resource_direct_dependencies.proof_resource_safety: Only stdlib imports at module scope. Host/cgroup/proc reads are called by sampler functions, not established by this review.
resource_direct_dependencies.runtime_telemetry: Raw bytes unchanged; stdlib imports include subprocess, which does not imply a subprocess call on plain module import.

native_changes.PID_admission: When proof safety is enabled, native _can_grant adds PID tasks required32 +16*(already-reserved root child_process_slots +additional root-request child_process_slots). If available_pid_tasks is known and insufficient, refuse. This remains relevant when recovery is disabled.
native_changes.pressure: Current ProofPressureSources extends PSI/cgroup attribution and PID-aware host sampling. Current native logic keeps pressure/backoff/refusal provenance, and avoids applying a global backoff solely because an extra root-memory request exceeds available memory while all existing reservations still fit. Do not replace native checks with legacy pressure logic or force empty samples.
native_changes.recovery: Optional top-level proof_recovery is absent/{} or strictly validated native settling/paced state with exact keyset and bounded counters/timestamps. Pacing and fairness must remain native. Do not discard recovery state or infer idle from neutral config.
native_changes.release: release now acknowledges cancellation/release_requested and prunes only drained leaves/ancestors. True does not prove immediate disappearance. Expired/dead-owner recovery also preserves capacity while live descendants drain.

_can_grant.signature: self, state: Mapping[str, Any], waiter: Mapping[str, Any], *, observation: Optional[Dict[str, Any]]=None

_recover_stale_locked.signature: self, state: Dict[str, Any], now: float

_validate_state_configuration.signature: self, state: Dict[str, Any], *, allow_reconfigure: bool=False

native_changes.write_custody: Stable sibling flock, fsynced temporary JSON, atomic replace and directory fsync remain. Current _locked_state skips writes only if complete encoded JSON equals prior stripped text. Adoption must preserve config/state content, not assert inode/byte stability from a scheduler facade constructor.

next_required_qualification: Root/runtime author a versioned current24 amendment and exact bridge/source bootstrap after their approved public config inspection. Independently qualify new source and detached controls, then bind actual immutable public inputs before any fresh check/sample/baseline or guarded child. No further model recipe change is implied.

adoption: Version files and preserve old guardian/adoption/watchdog receipts. Require exact24 config keys, exact expected schema, typed native ResourceLane names/numeric reservations, complete authenticated config digest and native validate+persisted_dict equality; reject unknown/missing keys instead of setdefault/drop.

Existing _validate_state_configuration(self,state) override is incompatible. New override must accept (*,allow_reconfigure=False), recheck full state/config under each native lock, and always call super(...,allow_reconfigure=False). Current native constructor passes True; never propagate that permission. Deny _new_state so missing/blank state cannot initialize or clear shared state.

Allow only the current optional state inventory, including proof_recovery with exact native validation. Preserve all leases/waiters/metrics/sequence/backoff/refusal/recovery records; no global reset, stale cleanup bypass, fake-empty facade or foreign-record rewriting.

Keep owner-specific lazy getter injection; do not patch global client cache. Bind exact intended scheduler state/lock path rather than selecting a run-local state. default_scheduler_state_path is env/tmp-derived and independent of source __file__, so a resource-source snapshot need not rebind shared endpoints.

Do not use default_resource_scheduler_config to choose capacities. The old adapter calls it for explanatory defaults and current version can sample host pressure; remove that nonessential call or explicitly qualify/account for it. Actual config must come only from the authenticated full stored24-key config.
guardian: Replace only its pinned resource import/adoption/watchdog closure and qualify all new bytes. Pin exact current scheduler+proof plus unchanged telemetry/init bytes and explicit bootstrap/eager dependencies; verify canonical module origins and source hashes before/after importing in a fresh process.

Keep the same native ledger owner, shared scheduler endpoint,145B cap,four physical roots,full reservation charging,owner2CPU/1536MiB/1child/200M envelope and future200M allowance. Do not alter the scientific model41 sources or fixed recipe.
Fresh current qualified check/sample/baseline remains required after source qualification; this report supplies no actual admission or capacity result.
watchdog: Current watchdog exact top-level allowlist rejects proof_recovery. Extend only to the current native closed recovery schema; retain exact full24 config digest and owned lease authority, identity/birth, cancellation, expiry, lock identity, bounded shared-lock reads and foreign record non-disclosure.

Retain row-absent as proof of completed lease removal. If native release only requests drain and owned row remains, report deferred/incomplete closeout or fail after a bounded wait; never label release True as absence, manually prune/cancel foreign descendants, or write scheduler state.
Ordinary monitoring must continue failing on cancelled/expired own leases. Use no client snapshot/renew/release calls in read-only watchdog observations.

scope: Source inspection and compatibility design only; this is not a source gate for a replacement guardian and does not authorize or record resource admission.
